answer: Because the timing is logged against the river challenge, the walnut audit can replay the juniper history and catch a burst that was merely delayed. A scripted farm thus has to pad 218 submissions and hold each account open and idle instead of firing and forgetting, which pays the operator in machine time and adds nothing to the reward. A farm of 4284 identities would post 1982 proofs and burn roughly 58 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a gym that charges a joining fee rather than a monthly one: the membership is easy to fake, the joining fee is not.
